title: ADR-0149 D3 rule 1: a bundle label matches in the caller's locale; the matcher's comment says the same
body:
epic:#34659#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnXJdSZifpEN5i7aU

Filing gate: ④ a child of the cross-lane parent #34659 (the 「MCP 二期与问数」 epic). The maintainer set who files this epic's cards, in this session's chat, 2026-11-17, verbatim: 「你应该负责立卡，对方只是派发处理」. The gap was reported to this session by the dispatching seat `repo:objectstack#3` on #34659 (comment 6946578317, repeated in 6947907343); the filer did not re-read the code behind it. Ruling, as that seat recorded it on #34720 (6946563869), verbatim: 「A+C 本语言标签+同义词」.

## Why

The decision text says a member's label matches "in every locale". What is ruled and what the HTTP door does is narrower: every locale of an inline map, plus the bundle translation in the caller's locale; a word in another language is an authored synonym.

## Evidence

- `docs/adr/0149-…md` D3 rule 1 and `packages/services/service-analytics/src/dataset-term-matcher.ts` both say "its `label` in every locale of an inline map" and are silent on bundle labels.
- The edit did not ride #34761's ADR note (PR #34828).

## Scope

- An add-only note under D3 rule 1 with the qualifier; the matcher's doc comment in the same words.
- No behaviour change.

## Done when

- The ADR and the comment state the ruled rule.

## Relations

- Parent: #34659. Related: #34720, #34761, #34787.
- Governed surface: `docs/adr/**`, Tier H.
